svg.title: Modular Monolith to Microservices Extraction
svg.desc: A modular monolith keeps ports explicit so scheduler, execution, effect delivery, and operator control can later split without changing safety contracts.
svg.text: From One Spring Boot App to Safety-Preserving Services
Split ownership only after the ports, stable IDs, fence checks, and durable handoffs are already explicit.
Phase 2 - microservices with the same contracts
Non-negotiable extraction rule: the execution service owns the PostgreSQL fence check and commits checkpoint + execution + outbox atomically.
Do not replace the durable outbox with a best-effort synchronous call or treat broker order as a fencing token.
Scale services independently; preserve operation ID, namespace epoch, membership revision, region epoch, contract version, and fencing token end to end.
